name: Snakeskin Vest

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus : +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class .

effects.name: Search
effects.tooltip: Search +10 : Passive: +10 Competence bonus to the Search skill.

effects.name: Spot
effects.tooltip: Spot +10 : Passive: +10 Competence bonus to the Spot skill.

effects.name: Proof Against Poison
effects.tooltip: Proof Against Poison +4 : This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +4 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 5 + their Fortitude save).

effects.name: Greater Nimbleness
effects.tooltip: Greater Nimbleness : This suit of armor looks much less restrictive than others of its type. A suit of armor that has this property has a maximum Dexterity bonus 2 higher than normal, and its armor check penalty is reduced by 4.

flavor_text: Eerily, it seems this vest was made from the hides of dozens of medusa snakes. Something of the snakes lives on in the vest and it will bestow its wearer with the same alertness the snakes had in life.

source.raw: Frame Work , end chests, Dorris ' chests
